reviewer_statement: Signed by Claude on Cooper Ross's explicit written instruction, as his delegate. Cooper did not personally review this evidence before this receipt was written. The proposal (ncaaf-betting-lab #4) describes itself as 'against the evidence': no allowlist evidence bundle was ever built for this lab, no provider fetch has run, and no market has been measured against real prices.
